items.title: I made a free iPhone app for counting down to things with friends
items.body: Hey everyone! I've been working on Nudge, a little app for the things you're looking forward to: a trip with friends, a birthday, a reunion, or finally seeing your partner again, etc.    Nudge on the App Store    You make a countdown and share it with the people involved. While you're waiting, you can send little emoji or message nudges, add photos to the countdown, and keep it on your Home Screen or Lock Screen.   It's free, including the widgets. No ads, no subscription, and no separate account to create. It uses iCloud for storing the data.   I'm still growing it, and I'd love people to try it with their friends and tell me what feels fun, confusing, or missing. I want to keep improving it with the people who use it and grow from there. items.title: I built a free app to track maintenance for everything you own (home, cars, tools). Looking for testers
items.body: I kept forgetting when I last changed the furnace filter, rotated the tires or flushed the water heater, so I built **Maintainly**: one place for everything that needs regular upkeep.   **What it does**   - Add your home, cars, appliances and tools from 30+ built-in maintenance schedules, or answer a 1-minute setup quiz   - Tasks come due by date **or** by miles/hours, whichever comes first   - A budget view estimates what's coming up each month, and learns from what you actually paid   - Share a location with family, a roommate or a tenant, as an editor or view-only   - Keep a service log with notes, readings and costs   **Try it without signing up:** tap "Continue as guest".
